name: Skatås - Kåsjön
description: Skatås to Kåsjön. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
utilities: Delsjöområdet / Delsjön nature reserve access metadata (service)
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Official GPX repeats each coordinate three times; de-duplicate before length, simplification or QA processing.
Official GPX is older than Stage 1-2 files, with metadata time 2021-10-25 and CDN Last-Modified 2021-12-01, so stale-risk is nonzero.
Stale-risk is mitigated because current WST tokenized API and Naturkartan expose the same line and OSM corroborates closely.
Use WST GPX as durable source; do not depend on tokenized API URL.

facilities.name: Härlanda tjärn service cluster
facilities.description: Bathing area with kiosk/cafe, drinking water and toilets in WST; Naturkartan lists cafe/kiosk, jetties, playground, outdoor shower, toilets including accessible toilet, grill site and ramp. Coordinate variants exist between WST, Naturkartan main object and separate beach/fireplace objects. Food/water/toilet availability may be seasonal or opening-dependent.

facilities.name: Getryggen / Vindskydd "Gött läge"
facilities.description: Wind shelter/rest point with fireplace and view from Getryggen; WST says the shelter/fireplace were built by Göteborg city in early 2025. Duplicate/variant Naturkartan coordinates around [57.705716, 12.068702] and [57.705683, 12.068702]. Field report notes rocky ground makes tent pitching hard; do not imply campsite.

facilities.name: Blacktjärn rastplats
facilities.description: Rest point at Blacktjärn, directly by the route.

facilities.name: Vindskydd Prästtjärn
facilities.description: Shelter near Prästtjärn late in the stage; Partille lists one grill place at Vindskydd Prästtjärn. Slightly off the main line; model as near-route shelter/fireplace.

facilities.name: Parkering, Kåsjöns Motionscentral / Åstebo
facilities.description: Parking/access point near the official Kåsjön endpoint and Åstebo. Public Naturkartan place page for this object returned 404 on access date; coordinate comes from map/API neighbour object.

facilities.name: Delsjöområdet / Delsjön nature reserve access metadata
facilities.description: Broad protected/outdoor area context for the first half of the stage; use only for rules/access metadata such as reserve information, designated fireplaces and entrance waste handling. Do not import as precise point facility.
